Confidence intervals for
squared semipartial correlation coefficients
and Cohen's f-squared
are generated using
the `SCorSqNB()` and `FSqNB()` functions from the `betaNB` package.
In this example,
we use the data set and the model used in
[betaNB: Example Using the BetaNB Function](example-beta-nb.html).


``` r
library(betaNB)
```




``` r
df <- betaNB::nas1982
```

### Regression

Fit the regression model using the `lm()` function.


``` r
object <- lm(QUALITY ~ NARTIC + PCTGRT + PCTSUPP, data = df)
```

### Nonparametric Bootstrap


``` r
nb <- NB(object)
```

### Squared Semipartial Correlation Coefficients

The semipartial correlation is signed,
and its interval may contain zero.
`SCorSqNB()` returns the image of the signed interval under squaring.
It is not the interval of squared draws.


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>               est       lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.079538508 0.3090675
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.035230784 0.2240057
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.008499299 0.1377079
```


``` r
SCorSqNB(nb, level = 0.95, type = "bca")
#>               est       lower     upper
#> NARTIC  0.1858925 0.097478845 0.3416968
#> PCTGRT  0.1176542 0.048384858 0.2616506
#> PCTSUPP 0.0568722 0.009785787 0.1425535
```

### Cohen's f-Squared


``` r
out <- FSqNB(nb, alpha = 0.05)
```

## Methods

### summary


``` r
summary(out, type = "pc")
#> Call:
#> FSqNB(object = nb, alpha = 0.05)
#> 
#> Cohen's f-squared (fsq) and local f-squared
#> type = "pc"
#>            est     se    R   2.5%  97.5%
#> fsq     4.1158 1.6673 5000 2.2800 8.6691
#> NARTIC  0.9510 0.4217 5000 0.3762 2.0307
#> PCTGRT  0.6019 0.3078 5000 0.1929 1.3994
#> PCTSUPP 0.2909 0.2219 5000 0.0441 0.8723
```

### coef


``` r
coef(out)
#>       fsq    NARTIC    PCTGRT   PCTSUPP 
#> 4.1157764 0.9509843 0.6018924 0.2909455
```

### vcov


``` r
vcov(out)
#>               fsq     NARTIC      PCTGRT     PCTSUPP
#> fsq     2.7800077 0.42193057 0.226517243 0.169062820
#> NARTIC  0.4219306 0.17785866 0.026083932 0.018684179
#> PCTGRT  0.2265172 0.02608393 0.094755689 0.006418312
#> PCTSUPP 0.1690628 0.01868418 0.006418312 0.049260253
```

### confint


``` r
confint(out, level = 0.95, type = "pc")
#>              2.5 %   97.5 %
#> fsq     2.27998333 8.669086
#> NARTIC  0.37620335 2.030744
#> PCTGRT  0.19292711 1.399364
#> PCTSUPP 0.04411416 0.872278
```
